summary: InclusionAI's finance-focused Ling 3.0 Flash Fin (256K context, 32K output, reasoning and function calling) is free on Vercel AI Gateway through September 25, 2026. Model id inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free returns an error after the offer ends; the non-free id bills at standard rates afterward.
claim_steps: Create a Vercel account and provision an AI Gateway API key (npx vercel ai-gateway setup, or vercel ai-gateway coding-agents setup for coding agents).
Call model inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free for a guaranteed hard stop after Sep 25, or inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin (bills at standard rates afterward).

social_proof.title: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin now available on AI Gateway for free — Vercel Changelog
social_proof.text: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin from Inclusion AI is now available on AI Gateway and free to use through September 25. inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free returns an error after the offer ends, preventing future charges.
